description:
## Problem (observed)
`benchbox/cli/commands/run.py` was one line under its size limit on develop; the platform-selector fix pushed it to 3,320 lines and failed `tests/system/test_module_size_thresholds.py`. The entry was re-baselined by hand (its comment already lists many re-baselines). Each change that touches the CLI repeats this.

## Change
Extract cohesive groups out of `run.py` (platform and selector resolution, mode resolution and availability checks, the benchmark compatibility gate) into modules under `benchbox/cli/`, keeping imports for existing callers and tests working.

## Guardrails (must preserve)
- No behaviour change; the CLI test suites pass unchanged.
- Tests that import private helpers from `benchbox.cli.commands.run` keep working or are updated in the same PR.

## Process guardrails
- One PR per item against `develop`, via the AGENTS.md worktree flow.
- Verification ladder: `uv run -- python -m pytest -m fast -q`, `uv run -- ruff check .`, `uv run -- ruff format --check .` and `uv run -- ty check`; then `make pr-preflight` and `make pr-open`.
- Stage explicit paths; never `git add -A`. Re-read every anchor before editing.
